plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.taglineHtml: Eval-driven improvement, plus the harness to drive it
plugins.summaryHtml: Two parts form one loop. An edit → eval → keep/discard engine improves code, prompts, or docs. It scores each change with a shell command, an LLM judge, or both. It shows progress in a live Artifact dashboard. A harness builder measures project health in six categories. It creates feedback loops, evals, sensors, and context management advisories. It then fixes the top-ranked issue through the same loop.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 以評測驅動改進，並提供驅動它的 harness
zhTW.summaryHtml: 外掛由兩個部分組成一個循環。核心是「編輯 → 評測 → 保留或捨棄」引擎。引擎可以改進程式碼、提示詞或文件。引擎用 shell 指令、LLM 評審或兩者，為每次修改評分。進度顯示在即時的 Artifact 儀表板上。Harness 建構器從六個類別衡量專案健康度。建構器會建立回饋循環、評測、感測器，以及管理脈絡的建議。然後，建構器用同一個循環修正排名最高的問題。

plugins.oneLiner: Eval-driven improvement loop (keep/discard with a live Artifact dashboard) plus a dev-lifecycle harness builder that measures project health and creates feedback loops, evals, and sensors. Inspired by karpathy/autoresearch.

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-build
commands.descriptionHtml: Menu-driven scaffolder for harness components: feedback loop, eval loop, sensor, or context-mgmt advisory. Writes Tier-1 artifacts into your project's .claude/.

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-check
commands.descriptionHtml: Scan project health across code quality, tests, runtime, architecture, scriptability, and harness completeness. Produces a scored harness report with impact-ranked improvements

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-improvement
commands.descriptionHtml: Execute improvement loop on the top-ranked harness issue: auto-generates eval from probes and spawns the autoresearch:experimenter agent

commands.name: /autoresearch:improve
commands.descriptionHtml: Iteratively improve any artifact using an edit-eval-keep/discard loop with live dashboard

skills.name: experiment-loop
skills.descriptionHtml: Core iteration logic for autoresearch: edit target, run eval, keep or discard, update dashboard, repeat.

skills.name: harness-probes
skills.descriptionHtml: Guide for adding custom probes to the harness check system.

publish the live improvement dashboard as a private Claude Artifact. The dashboard now uses inline SVG and no external assets.

keep/discard no longer requires git. The experiment loop now snapshots target files into .autoresearch/snapshot/ instead of committing and checking out, so /autoresearch:improve runs against any directory, not just a git repo.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.taglineHtml: Multi-agent PR review with a per-repo policy layer
plugins.summaryHtml: Runs five reviewers in parallel on a PR: correctness, tests, security, ops, and simplicity (ponytail and /simplify rules). If the repo has a local review policy, a sixth reviewer cites the repo's own red-flags, pitfalls, and hotspots. Includes refresh-policy, which learns that policy from merged git and PR history.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 多代理 PR 審查，加上各 repo 自己的審查政策
zhTW.summaryHtml: 外掛在 PR 上平行執行五個審查員。五個審查員負責正確性、測試、安全、維運與簡潔度。簡潔度審查採用 ponytail 與 /simplify 規則。如果 repo 有本地審查政策，第六個審查員會引用它。政策記錄該 repo 自己的警訊、陷阱與熱點。refresh-policy 從已合併的 git 與 PR 歷史學習這份政策。

plugins.oneLiner: Multi-agent PR review: five common reviewers (correctness, tests, security, ops, simplicity) plus an optional repo-specific policy reviewer that reads a local .review-policy/ dir.

commands.name: /code-reviewer:review-pr

skills.name: refresh-policy

plugins.oneLiner: Distill your writing voice into reusable tone presets and rewrite existing text to sound human (not AI) in zh-TW or English — meaning always preserved.

plugins.name: adhd-review
plugins.summaryHtml: One ruleset, three layers. Layer 1 shapes every reply — lead with the action, number multi-step work with time estimates, cut preamble/recap/closers, state errors matter-of-factly. Layer 2 governs the final turn of substantial multi-step work with Review-Ready buckets — ✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do, blockers before FYI, each ask naming why it's yours. A Visual Layer draws non-linear flow-shaped concepts — branches, loops, state changes, hierarchies — as fenced ASCII diagrams instead of prose, while linear steps stay numbered lists. Applies to the human-facing thread only: a default-on SessionStart hook injects the rules into the main session, so subagent returns stay full-detail. On by default — installing the plugin shapes the main thread out of the box; set CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0 to silence a session. Toggle per session with /adhd-review-mode.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 回覆先講行動，阻礙排在參考資訊之前
zhTW.summaryHtml: 一套規則，分成三層。第 1 層調整每一則回覆。回覆先寫行動，多步驟工作加上編號與時間估計。回覆刪除開場白、重述與結尾，錯誤只陳述事實。第 2 層管理大型多步驟工作的最後一則回覆。這則回覆使用 Review-Ready 分類：✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do。阻礙排在參考資訊之前，每個請求都說明為何由你決定。視覺層把非線性的流程概念畫成 ASCII 圖，取代文字說明。圖放在程式碼區塊中。這類概念包括分支、迴圈、狀態變化與階層。線性步驟仍然用編號清單。規則只套用在面向使用者的主對話。預設開啟的 SessionStart hook 會把規則注入主工作階段。因此，子代理的回傳仍然保留完整細節。外掛預設開啟，安裝後主對話立即套用規則。如果要關閉某個工作階段，請設定 CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0。用 /adhd-review-mode 可以切換單一工作階段。

plugins.oneLiner: ADHD-friendly per-reply shaping merged with Review-Ready blocker/FYI handoff summaries. Shapes the human-facing thread only — subagent returns stay full-detail.

skills.name: adhd-review-mode
skills.descriptionHtml: Use to toggle the adhd-review reply style for the current session.

config.name: CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW
config.descriptionHtml: Per-session kill switch. On by default — installing the plugin auto-applies the style to every new main session. Set to 0 to disable it for that session; unset (or 1) re-enables. The style targets the main thread only; subagents never inherit it.

changes.html: ship the reply rules through the SessionStart hook only. The plugin no longer ships an output style, so you never set outputStyle for it. code-diff format picker rule now demands verbatim code lines, not intent summaries
add Language Layer that enforces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English as mandatory on every reply (all 53 rules + 8 general recommendations)
expand Visual Layer with technique vocabulary (pseudocode, call trees, component/file trees, mermaid, diffs, HTML artifacts)
add format picker for content-type to view mapping (sequence diagrams, diff view, flow diagrams, done/action view)

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.taglineHtml: No claim without a receipt (trigger test)
plugins.summaryHtml: A Stop hook that enforces provable claims. When the finished turn asserts a FACT: or a completion ('verified', 'tests pass', 'fixed', 'done'), a free deterministic prefilter checks it against that turn's real tool calls; only genuinely ambiguous claims escalate to a fresh-context Haiku judge. Unbacked claims are flagged with a ⚠ note (default warn mode) — or hard-gate the turn in block mode, where Claude must prove each with a real tool call or downgrade it to ASSUME: — bounded to one challenge per claim per session (ledger + stop_hook_active backstop). Enforces the fact-assume discipline (FACT = provable if challenged) that RLHF's confident 'done' quietly erodes. On by default and fail-open; set CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 to disable. /receipts prints the session's audit ledger and sets the mode.

zhTW.summaryHtml: receipts 是一個 Stop hook，要求每個主張都能證明。回合結束時，如果回覆宣稱 FACT: 或完成，receipts 會檢查它。完成的說法包括 'verified'、'tests pass'、'fixed'、'done'。免費的確定性預篩先用該回合真實的工具呼叫比對主張。只有真正模糊的主張，才交給全新脈絡的 Haiku 評審。沒有證據的主張會加上 ⚠ 註記，這是預設的 warn 模式。block 模式會擋下該回合。Claude 必須用真實的工具呼叫證明每個主張，或把它降級為 ASSUME:。每個主張在每個工作階段只挑戰一次，由 ledger 與 stop_hook_active 做後援。外掛落實 fact-assume 原則：FACT 必須在受到質疑時可以證明。RLHF 帶來的自信「done」會悄悄侵蝕這個原則。外掛預設開啟，出錯時放行（fail-open）。設定 CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 可以停用。/receipts 會列出工作階段的稽核 ledger，並設定模式。

plugins.oneLiner: Stop-hook claim auditor — every **FACT:** / 'verified' / 'tests pass' claim must trace to a real tool call in the transcript, or Claude is flagged (or blocked, in block mode) until it proves the claim or downgrades it to **ASSUME:**. Hybrid deterministic prefilter + fresh-context Haiku judge. On by default (mode: warn), fail-open.

commands.name: /receipts:receipts
commands.descriptionHtml: Show this session's receipts audit ledger, or set the audit mode: /receipts [block|warn|report|default].

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS
config.descriptionHtml: Master switch. On by default — installing the plugin activates the auditor. Set to 0 to disable it for a session (1 also works, redundantly).

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS_MODE
config.descriptionHtml: warn (default) = allow the turn but inject a ⚠ note listing unbacked claims; block = hard-gate them until proven/downgraded; report = silent audit log only. Change per session with /receipts block|warn|report (persists until /receipts default); the /receipts override file takes precedence over this env var.

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS_MODEL
config.descriptionHtml: Model for the fresh-context judge that resolves the ambiguous claims the deterministic prefilter can't settle.

changes.html: the labeled fixture now stores each claim's real turn (turn_text, final_text) for the 53 rows whose transcript still exists, so the eval scores extraction the way production sees it instead of feeding it the lone claim as if it were the whole turn.
recall goes 0.200 to 0.600 on the same labels. Two mid-turn narrations stop being scored as claims, because a completion verb only counts in the final message, and two real bluffs start being caught.
tool evidence is stored only on the adjudicated rows, which are the ones labeled for what classify decides. Storing it everywhere put a single 249 KB turn in the fixture.
attach_turn_context.py rebuilds the fixture from the transcripts, so labels added later can pick up their turn context while it is still on disk.

a lone slug or file name no longer backs a claim. The verbatim span must contain at least two words, because an ls line carrying a handover's name was backing the table cell that claimed it had been archived.

contradict a success claim only when exactly one command in the turn looks like a test, build or lint run. With several runs there is no cheap way to attribute the failure, and picking the failing one called true claims bluffs: "Test 1 passes" was contradicted by an unrelated command reporting "1 error".

drop "works" from the completion verbs. It reads as an observation in "the fix works" and as an opinion in "it works best as a secondary cross-check", and the second sense had a real analysis paragraph logged as a bluff.
on the labeled set: precision 1.000 (was 0.250), recall 0.200, escalation_rate 0.419, dropped_at_extraction 69. All three fixes trade flagging for deferral, so precision rises while recall holds.

a claim is backed only when tool output repeats a run of it word for word (24 characters or more). Shared vocabulary proved nothing: replaying 71 real ledger turns showed 47 of 52 backed verdicts resting on one shared word against a median claim of 8, so "W2a is done: 55 tests pass" came back backed by an agent's boilerplate line containing "files".
scope the failure signal to the tool that ran the work. An unrelated gh call exiting 1 in the same turn used to mark a true "All 15 tests pass" as a bluff.
replay_ledger.py rejoins a ledger claim to the transcript turn that produced it, so an old .log row can be re-judged against its real evidence.
10 ledger claims adjudicated against their full turn evidence by a fresh-context subagent, each row carrying that evidence so the eval exercises the evidence rules.
on the labeled set: precision 0.250, recall 0.200, escalation_rate 0.351, dropped_at_extraction 69. The first two were 0.000 before, because the label set held no positive class.
baseline (provisional labels, structural non-claims only) on the labeled set: precision 0.000, recall 0.000, escalation_rate 0.406, dropped_at_extraction 64
audit the final assistant message, not every line of the turn. Table rows, headings, and **ASSUME:** lines are no longer claims.
a claim is backed only when a tool's OUTPUT shows it. A file name in a tool input no longer counts.
every verdict carries evidence, and the ledger is JSONL.
unproven records a claim the judge could not reach, which used to be logged as backed.

run the Haiku judge from a neutral folder with --safe-mode and no tools. A judge call no longer loads plugins, hooks, skills, agents, MCP servers, or CLAUDE.md. A test call used about 3,600 input tokens, down from about 44,000 in 0.2.1.
rewrite prose in commands/receipts.md and this changelog to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
default-on with per-session opt-out
initial release, a claim-verification Stop hook
tuned prefilter (autoresearch iterations: 75→100 score)

plugins.name: obsidian-kit
plugins.taglineHtml: One plugin for the vault: draw, format, tag
plugins.summaryHtml: create-excali and update-excali build Excalidraw drawings through ExcalidrawAutomate, lint the geometry, and review the real PNG render. format-note writes and checks notes by their note-type (map, concept, takeaway, literature, fleeting) and keeps the ASCII-diagram and callout rules of the old visualize skill. migrate-notes sets note-type across a vault and renames map notes, as one approved plan. audit-tags finds false, duplicate, typo, and off-taxonomy tags and applies one approved rename plan with backups. handover-new, handover-wrap-up, handover-init-org, and handover-init-service create and wrap up handover documents backed by the vault. session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend turn a working session into reflection take-aways and, after one approval, Zettelkasten cards in the vault. A dedicated skill writes and checks controlled Traditional Chinese inside the vault. A SessionStart hook primes Claude to treat the obsidian CLI as the source of truth. Vault opinions live in the vault file .obsidian-kit.json. No cross-plugin deps.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 一個外掛管好筆記庫：繪圖、格式、標籤
zhTW.summaryHtml: create-excali 與 update-excali 用 ExcalidrawAutomate 建立 Excalidraw 圖。這兩個 skill 會檢查幾何，並審查實際輸出的 PNG。format-note 依筆記類型撰寫與檢查筆記。筆記類型包括 map、concept、takeaway、literature 與 fleeting。format-note 保留舊 visualize skill 的 ASCII 圖與 callout 規則。migrate-notes 為整個筆記庫設定筆記類型，並重新命名 map 筆記。這些變更合成一份計畫，核准後才執行。audit-tags 找出錯誤、重複、錯字與不在分類表中的標籤。它套用一份核准過的重新命名計畫，並先建立備份。handover-new、handover-wrap-up、handover-init-org 與 handover-init-service 建立並收尾交接文件。交接文件存放在筆記庫中。session-wrap-up、session-pick-up 與 session-recommend 把工作階段整理成反思重點。核准一次後，它們會在筆記庫中建立 Zettelkasten 卡片。一個專用 skill 在筆記庫中撰寫與檢查受控繁體中文。SessionStart hook 引導 Claude 以 obsidian CLI 為準。筆記庫的偏好設定存放在筆記庫檔案 .obsidian-kit.json 中。外掛不依賴其他外掛。

plugins.oneLiner: Work in an Obsidian vault with Claude Code: Excalidraw drawings in a house style, fixed note formats by note-type, a tag audit with one approved plan, and an obsidian CLI primer.

skills.name: update-excali
skills.descriptionHtml: Refine an existing Obsidian Excalidraw drawing into the vault house style.

changes.html: stop linting Markdown files. The PostToolUse .md lint is removed, with SIMPLE_MANDARIN_LINT_EXCLUDE. The Stop check on Mandarin chat replies stays, renamed from mandarin-lint.py to mandarin-reply-check.py. The Mandarin rules still load at session start inside a vault.
absorb session-learner as session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend. session-pick-up now writes cards into the vault after one approval.
absorb hh as handover-new, handover-wrap-up, handover-init-org, and handover-init-service.
absorb simple-mandarin. Its rules and lint now run only inside a vault.
handover discovery uses the Obsidian tag index and the current taxonomy. The old grep for the retired handover tag matched nothing.
archiving moves the file and never renames it, so wikilinks keep resolving. The living and historical reference classifier is gone.
one vault resolver. HH_LIFEOS_ROOT, HH_ARCHIVE_ROOT, and CLAUDE_SIMPLE_MANDARIN are deleted. OBSIDIAN_KIT_MANDARIN and OBSIDIAN_KIT_OFFER_HANDOVER replace the two behavior toggles.
absorb the three session reflection skills as session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend.
session-pick-up gains a Phase 3 write step. It can save cards into the vault through format-note, gated by one AskUserQuestion approval.
format-note accepts a bold claim inside a quote or callout (> **claim**, > [!danger] **claim**).
format-note no longer asks a map directly in a type folder to be renamed, matching migrate-notes 1.0.1.
Sources: is optional for concept and takeaway notes. Related: stays required.
a literature note can name its source with > Link: <url>, > Source: <name>, or a Sources: line. A literature note beside a 00__map__ note needs none, because the map names the series source.
audit-tags ends a tag at the next #. A false tag glued to another one (PR #1/#3, #1-#10) is wrapped in backticks. 1.0.1 skipped 19 such tags in LifeOS.

one tag must be a prefix covering at least half of the other for audit-tags to suggest a duplicate. The abbreviation rule is gone, because on real tags it only produced false merges (ci→containers, sre→serverless, clickhouse→cli).
migrate-notes keeps the name of a map note that sits directly in a type folder such as Permanent/. It no longer renames the note after that folder.
rename note-visualizer to obsidian-kit. The visualize skill becomes format-note.
add create-excali and update-excali, moved from the LifeOS vault skill excalidraw-refine.
add migrate-notes and audit-tags.
absorb obsidian-markdown and obsidian-bases from kepano/obsidian-skills (MIT).
add a SessionStart primer for the obsidian CLI and defuddle.
the PostToolUse reminder returns additionalContext, so it reaches Claude. It used systemMessage, which only the user sees, so the reminder never steered the model.
the reminder fires only for Markdown files under a Zettelkasten/ folder. Before, it fired on every Markdown edit in every project, including READMEs and CHANGELOGs.

add a PostToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json + hooks/remind-visualize.py) that reminds Claude to apply the visualize principle on any markdown edit, in any project. Replaces the plugin's earlier "no hooks" design.
add a sequence-diagram style to the visual-patterns reference, for flows with 3+ participants trading ordered messages. Includes its own line and width budget.
rewrite the visualize skill's prose to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
initial release, a visualize skill with inline and batch modes
visual-patterns reference codifying concept-shape → diagram-type mapping, callout rules, and one-screen budget constraints
model-invoked proactive triggering on Zettelkasten/ note writes
